input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, user management domain. It serves Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include authentication, product, authorization. Core business data revolves around Product, User, UserRole. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
As a Customer, I want to manage authentication operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a Customer, I want to interact with authorization functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a Customer, I want to interact with token functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
